title: Every missed step when you're behind
caption: At level 15 with ticks kept only to level 10, Next up lists all four missed steps instead of the first two.

title: Later card names what opens next
caption: At level 20 the Later card names the step that opens first, the Ascension quest after its story quest, instead of a milestone title.

title: Spend all your points at once
caption: At level 25 with skill points and a stigma upgrade to spend, Next up lists every skill upgrade your points cover, not just four.
